svg.title: From Stack Exchange access to verified project results
svg.desc: Four-phase flowchart identifying the documented manual procedures, Python programs, Jupyter notebook, input files, generated results, and verification method used by the three implemented project routes.

text.tspan: MANUAL WEBSITE PROCEDURE · README.md: Data-dump access and preparation
A new or existing account provides

The downloaded archive is extracted into

Input: one or more question post IDs
One XML file. Each thread contains the

Selected fields follow the configured order;
unavailable source values create empty elements.
Question IDs, field names, and field order

VERIFICATION METHOD · README.md: Change verification and recording
Performed by: the selected Python program.
Every route validates its inputs and output publication.

Procedure: README.md → Change verification and recording
and clean-kernel notebook execution are inspected.
